context_requirements: Functional GABAergic signaling machinery, including GABAA receptors and/or GABA transporters, which is largely absent in the nine non-neuronal cancer lines used here
Expression of SLC6A1 (GAT1) or other GABA transporters at levels sufficient to modulate extracellular GABA
Expression of SIGMAR1 or GABRA3 in a signaling context that can be affected by uptake inhibition
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that matches known GABAergic pathway activation
Evidence of SIGMAR1-dependent transcriptional changes in lines expressing SIGMAR1
